decisions.reason: As a close-to-core modular product line in an expanding German machinery firm with in-house engineering and service capabilities, it likely remains worth carrying because uncertainty about its full potential is not clearly resolved and the incremental support cost is relatively low.

Because this hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm’s established filtration and fluid-handling offer, management would likely keep it on the market absent clear failure signals, though the broad portfolio creates some pressure to reallocate resources if demand disappoints.

This gravity band coolant filter is adjacent to the firm’s core systems business and can likely be supported through existing platforms and channels, so under real-options logic it is more sensible to keep than drop while market learning continues.
